text:
docs-bot: Automated link-scan found 403s for localized KB slugs under /kb/product-x/es/ on staging. Affected: 12 pages.

jordan: saw the alert this morning when QA hit a 403 on the Spanish guides. reproduction:

jordan: `curl -I https://staging.docs.redwood.ai/kb/product-x/es/installation`

marie: ugh. Any idea if it's a CDN redirect or frontmatter slug change?

siva: quick grep shows pages had `slug: product-x-install` renamed to `product-x-install-v2` last month. probably canonical mismatch.

jordan: i can try a sed replace across the repo if owners ok. example I ran locally:

jordan: ```bash
rg "slug: product-x-install" -n
# then
git grep -l "product-x-install" | xargs -I{} sed -i "s/product-x-install/product-x-install-v2/g" {}
```

marie: @siva are you the content owner for product-x docs?

siva: Yep, I'm the owner. I'll open a tiny PR that updates frontmatter and adds redirects in the frontmatter `aliases:` field for the old slug.

dan: please include a short smoke test checklist in the PR description (curl checks + spot-check 3 pages). also add me as reviewer if it's >1 file.

linda: can we target a quick merge window today? staging patch would let QA resume.

siva: will do. PR coming shortly: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4238 :construction:

marie: :thumbsup: i'll take a fast review once it's up.

jordan: small note — if anyone runs ripgrep, exclude `_site` and `node_modules` to avoid noise: `rg --hidden --glob "!_site/**" --glob "!node_modules/**" "product-x-install"`

siva: PR opened and assigned to @marie and @dan. tests: ran local link-checker and fixed two trailing slashes.

dan: looks fine, approved. schedule merge after 5pm to avoid interrupting midday deploys.

siva: merged the PR and kicked off a staging redeploy. cc @docs-bot to re-scan.

docs-bot: Re-scan queued for /staging; previous 12 failures -> 0 after patch. :white_check_mark:

linda: awesome, thanks everyone. QA can resume.

jordan: thanks @siva for the fast turnaround.
